# Leak corpus for the allowlist redactor's acceptance tests.
#
# One input per line. Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are skipped.
# Every input carries the needle `zqx` (compared case-insensitively) and no
# other name: nothing here is a real artist, album, track, person, host or
# path. The fixture user is `zqxuser`. The shapes come from the earlier
# redactor reviews (quoted media names before a colon, slash forms with a
# number-led second segment, backslash roots, secret words next to values,
# forged placeholders and forged log or crash lines); only their shape is kept.
#
# Markers the loader decodes, so a line stays one line:
#   <NL> line feed   <CR> carriage return   <TAB> tab
#   <NBSP> U+00A0    <ZWSP> U+200B          <LS> U+2028

# --- bare names, slash forms
